summary: Landed kernel/assemble.rs (segment gluing + deck identification + graph assembly) with the packet's public API: regions_identify (Rules A/B/C via the landed kernel/identity rule_a/rule_c, never proximity), c1_bound_of (outward-rounded enclosure comparison of both stored Hermite ends' positions/derivatives over the junction box, no snapping), glue -> Construction<GlueCert> (identity + TubeOverlapCert::try_new(shared_point, c1_bound) with the shared point as the nearer-pair float proposal; a near non-identifying pair refuses SliverOrNearOverlap, Inconclusive; a C1 disagreement refuses ClaimRefuted), deck_identify(&[ChainArc], period, unions) -> Construction<Vec<Break>> (exact i32/i64 deck sums - the chain chart data carries the periods, so no formal/deck.rs interval solver adapter is needed; Rule B closure via rule_b_transport on a physically-closed chain; per-edge |deck| > DECK_MAX refuses DeckExhausted, Inconclusive; emits one SegmentBreak::DeckStep break per seam crossing with the exact (chart, deck=k, u=P)/(chart, deck=k+1, u=0) parameter pair and a trivial same-arc tube overlap), and assemble(Vec<AnyArc>, Vec<Break>, Vec<Node>) -> Construction<CertifiedGraph> (every ArcEnd::Topo resolves to a Node whose NodeCert is the exhaustive Exact-or-AtTolerance match - the shape pin - every ArcEnd::Seg resolves to a Break, unresolved references refuse ClaimRefuted). kernel/mod.rs wires `pub mod assemble;` with a doc comment.
